name: Condición de Refugiado (Refugio)

qualifying_event.description: A refugee is a person forced to leave their country of origin or habitual residence due to persecution based on race, religion, nationality, membership of a social group, political opinion, or gender, and who is physically present in Costa Rican territory to file the claim.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Passport, birth certificate, criminal background documentation, and evidence supporting the persecution claim.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires meeting the persecution-based refugee criteria, assessed through an initial interview (issuing a 'carné de solicitante de refugio' with immediate work authorisation) followed by an eligibility interview that determines final status.

evidence_required.document: Application filed in person (border or, via migracion.go.cr's appointment portal, from within the country)
Passport, birth certificate, criminal background documentation (10 business days to submit if missing at the eligibility interview)

outcome.duration_length: not specified in sources reviewed for recognized refugee status; applicant card ('carné') held pending the eligibility interview

sources.title: UNHCR Costa Rica -- Solicitar refugio (asilo) en Costa Rica

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Costa Rica's initial build. Costa Rica has a real, actively-administered asylum system (historically one of the largest per-capita refugee-hosting countries in the Americas, largely Nicaraguan claimants) run by DGME (migracion.go.cr), which is referenced operationally in the source (appointment portal, phone line) but whose own pages were not reachable (403) in this pass -- sourced instead from UNHCR Costa Rica (tier 2, intergovernmental). work_rights set 'full' for BOTH applicants (immediate work authorisation on receiving the carné) and recognized refugees per the source -- a notably generous provision, confirmed at tier-2. pr_after_months left null: this route already appears as one basis for cr_permanent_residence's discretionary-Commission group, but no specific month count was stated for refugees specifically in the sources fetched.
